fluff.overview: Capellan infantry serve where BattleMechs and armor cannot be spared, which in the resource-constrained CCAF means nearly everywhere. The Xin Sheng movement revitalized the infantry arm alongside every other facet of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces, giving foot soldiers better equipment and renewed purpose. Field artillery platoons give CCAF ground commanders organic indirect fire support without requiring dedicated artillery vehicles. Operating crew-served tube or missile artillery pieces from mechanized transports, these platoons can displace and redeploy faster than vehicle-mounted artillery at the cost of lower rates of fire and less ammunition. Operating a Thumper artillery piece, these platoons provide light indirect fire support, effective for suppression and area denial against infantry and light vehicles.
